segments: Over black, the title card "Laundry" appears in white letters. The view opens a row of washing machines.
A man holding a bag approaches one of them, opens it, and starts putting his clothes in.
He turns around and starts looking around the laundromat. He looks concerned. His surroundings are deserted except for a bag left on a washing machine.
As he turns back to his washing machine, a woman suddenly appears on his left. She's also doing laundry. He looks at her, and then looks away and closes his washing machine door.
The screen fades to black and holds on black.
The view opens on a row of washing machines, but one of the machine's doors is already open. The same man approaches it and puts his clothes in.
He starts looking around again, turning in the exact same way as before. Again, the laundromat is empty except for the same bag, left in the exact position as before.
Like before, as he turns back to his washing machine, the same lady appears. She stands in the same position as before, but now she looks down, not doing any laundry. The screen cuts to black.
